newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down on harvest pressure.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down on harvest pressure.

text.p: Argentine cash maize slipped as harvest pressure weighed on bids in goodish volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

Prices paid to farmer for spot maize in Buenos Aires shed $2 to $108. Port congestion and a shortage of storage space was also helping buyers' bargaining power. Cash soybeans lost ground in middling trade as the market plodded lower after Chicago. There was also a suspicion that damage from weekend frosts was not as great as prices made out Monday. May soybeans lost $4 to $303. Buenos Aires sunflower seed lost $3 to $210 in moderate volume, influenced by soybeans.
